title: RunLedgerPinRecord
description: A pin line of .apegmsh/runs.jsonl (kind="pin"). The file interleaves two record kinds: run lines, which carry no 'kind' and validate against ledger.schema.json, and pin lines, which carry kind="pin" and validate against this one. Discriminate on the 'kind' field before validating; a pin line has no script/phase/ok and is correctly refused by the run schema.
